I. GENERAL

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates the authority of regional governments to regulate and manage their own governmental affairs directed towards accelerating the realization of public welfare through improved services, empowerment and community participation. The authority of Regional Governments is to make regional policies to provide services, increase participation, initiative, and community empowerment aimed at improving people's welfare.

The implementation of regional autonomy must always be oriented towards improving community welfare while always paying attention to the interests and aspirations that grow in society. Therefore, governmental affairs related to basic services such as basic education, health, fulfillment of minimum living needs, basic environmental infrastructure must be fulfilled.

Human rights are basic rights that are inherently attached to human beings by nature, are universal and lasting, so they must be protected, respected, maintained, and may not be ignored, reduced, or seized by anyone. In the context of Upholding Human Rights (HAM) to guarantee justice for every individual, efforts are made to prevent all forms of unbalanced treatment or treatment deemed detrimental to other parties, whether between individuals, between groups of individuals, or between individuals and between government and society, including the process of marginalization of women that causes women to be vulnerable to acts of violence, discrimination and exploitation in both domestic and public spheres.

Women have equal rights with men, but under certain discriminatory conditions, the government must carry out affirmative action so that the rights of women and women in vulnerable groups need to receive protection so that they do not experience violence and can live a decent life in accordance with the principles of humanity, equality and justice.

Women's empowerment and women's protection are implemented in order to realize gender equality and justice. To carry out these affairs, efforts are needed to increase the capacity of women's resources and strengthen gender mainstreaming institutions, through gender mainstreaming strategies and gender-disaggregated data.

The Government of Semarang Regency as the party that has the authority to regulate and protect the citizens of Semarang Regency, deems it necessary to continuously carry out and formulate regulations to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and women's protection in Semarang Regency.

This Regional Regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental conditions of women in fulfilling their rights and living needs as part of human rights from various fields of development, increase the commitment and effectiveness of regional governments in implementing policies, programs and activities and encourage the institutional capacity of government and society that improves the quality of life of women.

ELUCIDATION

ON

REGIONAL REGULATION OF SEMARANG REGENCY

NUMBER 1 OF 2015

CONCERNING

EMPOWERMENT AND PROTECTION OF WOMEN

I. GENERAL

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates the authority of regional governments to regulate and manage their own governmental affairs directed towards accelerating the realization of public welfare through improved services, empowerment and community participation. The authority of Regional Governments is to make regional policies to provide services, increase participation, initiative, and community empowerment aimed at improving people's welfare.

The implementation of regional autonomy must always be oriented towards improving community welfare while always paying attention to the interests and aspirations that grow in society. Therefore, governmental affairs related to basic services such as basic education, health, fulfillment of minimum living needs, basic environmental infrastructure must be fulfilled.

Human rights are basic rights that are inherently attached to human beings by nature, are universal and lasting, so they must be protected, respected, maintained, and may not be ignored, reduced, or seized by anyone. In the context of Upholding Human Rights (HAM) to guarantee justice for every individual, efforts are made to prevent all forms of unbalanced treatment or treatment deemed detrimental to other parties, whether between individuals, between groups of individuals, or between individuals and between government and society, including the process of marginalization of women that causes women to be vulnerable to acts of violence, discrimination and exploitation in both domestic and public spheres.

Women have equal rights with men, but under certain discriminatory conditions, the government must carry out affirmative action so that the rights of women and women in vulnerable groups need to receive protection so that they do not experience violence and can live a decent life in accordance with the principles of humanity, equality and justice.

Women's empowerment and women's protection are implemented in order to realize gender equality and justice. To carry out these affairs, efforts are needed to increase the capacity of women's resources and strengthen gender mainstreaming institutions, through gender mainstreaming strategies and gender-disaggregated data.

The Government of Semarang Regency as the party that has the authority to regulate and protect the citizens of Semarang Regency, deems it necessary to continuously carry out and formulate regulations to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and women's protection in Semarang Regency.

This Regional Regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental conditions of women in fulfilling their rights and living needs as part of human rights from various fields of development, increase the commitment and effectiveness of regional governments in implementing policies, programs and activities and encourage the institutional capacity of government and society that improves the quality of life of women.

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is Semarang Regency.
2. Regional Government is the administration of government affairs by the Regional Government and the Regional House of Representatives according to the principles of autonomy and assistance tasks with the principle of the widest possible autonomy within the system and principles of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia as referred to in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia.
3. Regional Government is the Regent and regional apparatus as elements of the Regional Government administration.
4. Regional House of Representatives of Semarang Regency hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution as an element of regional government administration.
5. Regent is the Regent of Semarang.
6. Regional Apparatus Work Unit in charge hereinafter referred to as SKPD in charge is a Regional Apparatus Work Unit that has main duties and functions in accordance with the related field.
7. Human Rights are a set of rights inherent in the nature and existence of human beings as creatures of God Almighty and are His gift that must be respected, upheld and protected by the state, law, Government, and every person for the sake of honor and protection of human dignity and worth.
8. Women's Empowerment is every effort to improve physical, mental, spiritual, social abilities, knowledge, and skills so that women are ready to be utilized according to their respective abilities.
9. Women's Protection is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
10. Discrimination Against Women is any distinction, exclusion or restriction made on the basis of sex which has the effect or purpose of reducing or eliminating the recognition, enjoyment or exercise of human rights and fundamental freedoms in the political, economic, social, cultural, civil or any other field by women, regardless of their marital status on the basis of equality between men and women.
11. Gender is a concept that refers to the differentiation of roles and responsibilities of men and women that occur as a result of and can be changed by the social and cultural conditions of society.
12. Gender Equality is the equality of conditions for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings so that they are able to play a role and participate in political, economic, social, cultural, defense and security activities, and equality in enjoying the results of development.
13. Society is individuals, families, groups and social organizations and/or community organizations.
14. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, husband-wife and their children, or father and children, or mother and children.
15. Labor Force is every person who is capable of doing work to produce goods and/or services either to meet their own needs or for society.
16. Worker/Laborer is every person who works by receiving wages or remuneration in other forms.

Article 12

Article 3

Women's Empowerment and Protection is implemented based on the principles of:

b. justice and gender equality;

Article 22

1. Implementation of Protection for female commercial sex workers as referred to in Article 13 letter i in order to provide health protection and enhancement of life skills as capital to improve social status.
2. Protection for female commercial sex workers as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:a. providing life skills capability;
b. facilitating reproductive health services; danc. preventing the occurrence of human trafficking.

Article 19

1. Implementation of protection for female heads of household as referred to in Article 13 letter f is in order to provide protection and prevention against forms of discrimination, negative stigma and economic empowerment for female heads of household.
2. Female heads of household as referred to in paragraph (1) receive protection rights for:
a. discriminatory actions and efforts to weaken the function of women as economic supporters of the family;
b. strengthening capacity and recognition as heads of household in their environment; and

Paragraph (3) Sufficiently clear.

Paragraph (4) Sufficiently clear.

Article 16

1. Implementation of protection for women with disabilities as referred to in Article 13 letter c is in order to provide protection and prevention against forms of discrimination including freedom from cruel, inhumane treatment, degrading human dignity, and freedom from exploitation.
2. Women with disabilities as referred to in paragraph (1) receive protection rights for:
a. guarantee of continuity and personal self-development;
b. participation in the fields of education, health, employment, politics, sports, arts and culture as well as utilization of information and communication technology;
c. accessibility of information, legal aid, mobility, social services; and
d. early intervention efforts including treatment and rehabilitation to improve their function and capacity.

Article 4

The objectives of this Regional Regulation are:
a. to empower women both individually and in groups and society at large so that they are able to live more independently; and
b. to prevent and address the risks of violence and vulnerability of women so that their survival can be fulfilled according to the principles of equality and justice.

Article 21

1. Implementation of protection for female disaster victims as referred to in Article 13 letter h is in order to provide protection during disasters and post-disaster.
2. Female disaster victims as referred to in paragraph (1) receive protection for:
a. access to decent housing;
b. health services;
c. access to information and legal consultation services; and
d. post-disaster recovery.

NUMBER 1 OF 2015

CONCERNING

EMPOWERMENT AND PROTECTION OF WOMEN

I. GENERAL

The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia mandates the authority of regional governments to regulate and manage their own governmental affairs directed towards accelerating the realization of public welfare through improved services, empowerment and community participation. The authority of Regional Governments is to make regional policies to provide services, increase participation, initiative, and community empowerment aimed at improving people's welfare.

The implementation of regional autonomy must always be oriented towards improving community welfare while always paying attention to the interests and aspirations that grow in society. Therefore, governmental affairs related to basic services such as basic education, health, fulfillment of minimum living needs, basic environmental infrastructure must be fulfilled.

Human rights are basic rights that are inherently attached to human beings by nature, are universal and lasting, so they must be protected, respected, maintained, and may not be ignored, reduced, or seized by anyone. In the context of Upholding Human Rights (HAM) to guarantee justice for every individual, efforts are made to prevent all forms of unbalanced treatment or treatment deemed detrimental to other parties, whether between individuals, between groups of individuals, or between individuals and between government and society, including the process of marginalization of women that causes women to be vulnerable to acts of violence, discrimination and exploitation in both domestic and public spheres.

Women have equal rights with men, but under certain discriminatory conditions, the government must carry out affirmative action so that the rights of women and women in vulnerable groups need to receive protection so that they do not experience violence and can live a decent life in accordance with the principles of humanity, equality and justice.

Women's empowerment and women's protection are implemented in order to realize gender equality and justice. To carry out these affairs, efforts are needed to increase the capacity of women's resources and strengthen gender mainstreaming institutions, through gender mainstreaming strategies and gender-disaggregated data.

The Government of Semarang Regency as the party that has the authority to regulate and protect the citizens of Semarang Regency, deems it necessary to continuously carry out and formulate regulations to provide guarantees for women's empowerment and women's protection in Semarang Regency.

This Regional Regulation is expected to be able to encourage efforts to improve the physical and mental conditions of women in fulfilling their rights and living needs as part of human rights from various fields of development, increase the commitment and effectiveness of regional governments in implementing policies, programs and activities and encourage the institutional capacity of government and society that improves the quality of life of women.

REGENT OF SEMARANG,

Considering:
a. that the empowerment of women is carried out so that women can actualize their potential optimally to participate in development in accordance with their capacity; b. that women as national assets who play a role in the process of continuation and creation of quality generations need to receive guarantees for the fulfillment of their rights and protection from acts of violence and discrimination in order to build society, nation and state; c. that based on Article 12 paragraph (2) letter b of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government it is stated in essence that the empowerment of women is a mandatory affair that must be implemented by regional governments; d. that based on Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government in the Appendix it is stated that the division of government affairs in the field of women's empowerment with one of the sub-affairs is the protection of women; e. that based on the considerations as referred to in letter a, letter b, letter c and letter d it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning Empowerment and Protection of Women; In View of:

CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is Semarang Regency.
2. Regional Government is the administration of government affairs by the Regional Government and the Regional House of Representatives according to the principles of autonomy and assistance tasks with the principle of the widest possible autonomy within the system and principles of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia as referred to in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia.
3. Regional Government is the Regent and regional apparatus as elements of the Regional Government administration.
4. Regional House of Representatives of Semarang Regency hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is a regional people's representative institution as an element of regional government administration.
5. Regent is the Regent of Semarang.
6. Regional Apparatus Work Unit in charge hereinafter referred to as SKPD in charge is a Regional Apparatus Work Unit that has main duties and functions in accordance with the related field.
7. Human Rights are a set of rights inherent in the nature and existence of human beings as creatures of God Almighty and are His gift that must be respected, upheld and protected by the state, law, Government, and every person for the sake of honor and protection of human dignity and worth.
8. Women's Empowerment is every effort to improve physical, mental, spiritual, social abilities, knowledge, and skills so that women are ready to be utilized according to their respective abilities.
9. Women's Protection is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
10. Discrimination Against Women is any distinction, exclusion or restriction made on the basis of sex which has the effect or purpose of reducing or eliminating the recognition, enjoyment or exercise of human rights and fundamental freedoms in the political, economic, social, cultural, civil or any other field by women, regardless of their marital status on the basis of equality between men and women.
11. Gender is a concept that refers to the differentiation of roles and responsibilities of men and women that occur as a result of and can be changed by the social and cultural conditions of society.
12. Gender Equality is the equality of conditions for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings so that they are able to play a role and participate in political, economic, social, cultural, defense and security activities, and equality in enjoying the results of development.
13. Society is individuals, families, groups and social organizations and/or community organizations.
14. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, husband-wife and their children, or father and children, or mother and children.
15. Labor Force is every person who is capable of doing work to produce goods and/or services either to meet their own needs or for society.
16. Worker/Laborer is every person who works by receiving wages or remuneration in other forms.
